title: Equipment on/off comparison
purpose: Test whether {target} contributes to the problem by switching it off and back on (A-B-A design).
preconditions: {target} can be switched off safely without affecting other equipment
Sensors stay in exactly the same place
confounds: Other equipment changing state at the same time
Switching {target} off also stops something else (shared power strip, cooling)
safety: Only switch equipment off if it is safe and normal to do so. Do not open equipment or bypass interlocks.

steps.title: Switch off
steps.instruction: Switch {target} OFF. Change nothing else. Wait until it has fully stopped (fans spun down).

steps.title: Switch on again
steps.instruction: Switch {target} back ON and let it reach normal operation.

steps.title: {target} ON again
steps.instruction: Record again with {target} on. This checks that nothing else changed.

success: A comparable on/off/on sequence exists for {target}.
